Stallion_Powerful_Hindlegs.description: Enormous, sinewy hindlegs pump with unbridled power and speed, enabling the quadrupedal creature to sprint across the battlefield with devastating charge attacks and graceful leaps that showcase unmatched athletic prowess.

Draft_Horse_Pillar_Hindlegs.description: Enormous and powerful, these draft horse hindlegs tower over the landscape, their thick, sinewy muscles coiled with latent strength, capable of bearing immense weight and delivering devastating blows, though they slow the creature's pace with each ponderous step.

Gazelle_Leaping_Hindlegs.description: Gazelle_Leaping_Hindlegs are slender, sinewy limbs that end in powerful, cloven hooves, capable of explosive bursts of speed and acrobatic leaps that allow their bearer to traverse rugged terrain with the fluid grace and agility of the fastest savannah runners.

Mountain_Goat_Climbing_Legs.description: Equipped with the sinewy strength and nimbleness of a mountain goat, these climbing legs allow for effortless scaling of sheer cliffs and precarious overhangs, granting unparalleled agility and balance, as well as the ability to traverse treacherous terrain with the grace and ease of a skilled acrobat.

Rhino_Massive_Hind_Pillars.description: Enormous and sturdy hind legs braced with thick, gnarled bones and sinewy muscles ripple with untapped power, capable of delivering devastating blows or absorbing the heaviest strikes, though they weigh the creature down slightly, impeding its agility.

Boar_Stout_Hindlegs.description: Enormous, muscular hindlegs bristling with raw power and resilience, designed for the relentless pursuit of prey through dense undergrowth, these boar-like appendages not only grant their bearer incredible strength and constitution but also the devastating skill of a thunderous charge.

Camel_Padded_Hindlegs.description: Thick, supple padding envelops the hindlegs of the creature, enhancing its resilience and balance, granting it an unwavering stride across rugged terrains while bolstering its constitution and agility.

Hippopotamus_Webbed_Hindlegs.description: These powerful, webbed hindlegs are both a testament to the creature's strength and its adaptation to aquatic environments, enabling swift swimming and powerful bursts through water while also providing a robust foundation on land, enhancing its resilience and endurance.

Zombie_Stag_Rotting_Hindlegs.description: The rotting hindlegs of the zombie stag, once powerful and graceful appendages of an ungulate, now serve as a grim testament to decay, their strength enhanced by the undead’s relentless tenacity, yet slowing the creature’s once nimble gait, while emitting a poisonous cloud that sickens any who dare approach too closely.

Ghost_Steed_Ethereal_Hindlegs.description: The Ghost Steed's ethereal hindlegs, a spectral blend of magic and bone, allow it to hover silently over even the thorniest terrain, granting both wisdom and agility to any rider fortunate enough to command its spectral form.
